$comment: Legal pages and acceptance (docs/legal.md). One source for the privacy policy, terms of service, refund policy, cookie policy and business details on apps/site, and for what the app asks at sign-up. `template: true` = the texts and the company values are a starting point for a lawyer to review, and every page says so; set it to false only once a lawyer has reviewed them and every example value is replaced (`pnpm check:legal` refuses example.com values then). Bump a document's `version` whenever its text changes: the API asks every user to accept a new terms or privacy version on their next visit, and `pnpm check:legal` fails when a text changed under an old version (config/legal.lock.json). `age.minimum`: self-attestation at sign-up (16 = GDPR default, 13 where only COPPA applies); `age.b2bOnly: true` drops the question. `processors`: what the stack can send personal data to, one entry per tool; the pages list only the ones in use (docs/legal.md, 'What is generated'). Never claim compliance in these texts.

company.address: 1 Example Street, 10000 Example City, Example Country

billing.taxNote: Prices exclude VAT and sales tax. Where tax applies, checkout adds it before you pay.

processors.name: This service (first party)
processors.purpose: Signing you in, keeping you signed in and remembering your cookie choices.
processors.data: Session identifiers, the consent choice.

cookies.name: better-auth.session_token
cookies.purpose: Keeps you signed in ("__Secure-" prefix on HTTPS).

cookies.name: better-auth.state
cookies.purpose: Protects a single sign-on (SSO) sign-in against forgery.

cookies.name: better-auth.better-auth-passkey
cookies.purpose: Holds the challenge while you register or use a passkey.

cookies.name: better-auth.admin_session
cookies.purpose: Support staff only: keeps their own session while they view the app as a user.

cookies.name: better-auth.two_factor
cookies.purpose: Holds a pending second sign-in step.

processors.name: Example Cloud Ltd (server and database hosting)
processors.purpose: Runs the application, its database and its job queue.
processors.data: All account and workspace data.

processors.name: Example Database Ltd (managed database)
processors.purpose: Hosts the application database when it is not on our own server.
processors.data: All account and workspace data.

processors.name: Example Backup Storage Ltd (off-site backups)
processors.purpose: Keeps encrypted copies of the database and files for disaster recovery.
processors.data: All account and workspace data, encrypted.

processors.name: Example Cloud Ltd (object storage)
processors.purpose: Stores uploaded files, data exports and the AI audit record.
processors.data: Files you upload, AI requests and responses.

processors.name: Example Mail Ltd (email delivery)
processors.purpose: Delivers sign-in codes, invitations and, if you opt in, product news.
processors.data: Email address, message content, delivery logs.

processors.name: AI model providers (listed on the "How we use AI" page)
processors.purpose: Generates AI features' output.
processors.data: The text sent to the model and its answer.

processors.name: AI vendor subscriptions (the model vendors of our CLI subscriptions)
processors.purpose: Generates AI features' output through vendor subscriptions.
processors.data: The text sent to the model and its answer.

processors.name: PostHog
processors.purpose: Product analytics, session replay, surveys and feature flags, after your consent.
processors.data: Pseudonymous user and organization ids, usage events, survey answers.

cookies.name: ph_*
cookies.purpose: Identifies the browser to PostHog across visits.

processors.name: Umami (self-hosted, cookieless)
processors.purpose: Counts page views and events without cookies or personal identifiers.
processors.data: Page path, referrer, browser type; no cookies.

processors.name: Google Analytics 4
processors.purpose: Traffic analytics, after your consent.
processors.data: Browser client id, page views, events.

processors.name: Yandex Metrika
processors.purpose: Traffic analytics and, if enabled, session replay, after your consent.
processors.data: Browser client id, page views, events.

processors.name: Formbricks
processors.purpose: In-app surveys, after your consent.
processors.data: Survey answers, the page they were given on.

processors.name: Langfuse
processors.purpose: Monitors the quality of AI answers, including your thumbs up or down.
processors.data: AI call metadata (no content), feedback scores.

processors.name: Sentry or GlitchTip (error tracking)
processors.purpose: Reports application errors so they can be fixed.
processors.data: Error details, scrubbed of user, request and extra data.

processors.name: Chatwoot (service desk)
processors.purpose: Answers your questions and problem reports.
processors.data: Name, email, user id, conversation messages.

cookies.name: cw_conversation
cookies.purpose: Keeps your support conversation open across pages.

processors.name: Telegram (support bot, when you use it)
processors.purpose: Lets you reach support through Telegram.
processors.data: Telegram user id, messages you send the bot.

processors.name: Plane or GitHub Issues (product tracker)
processors.purpose: Turns support requests, feedback and alerts into work items.
processors.data: The request's text with personal data redacted, a link back to the conversation.

processors.name: Twenty (customer records)
processors.purpose: Keeps the customer relationship record of your account.
processors.data: Name, email, organization, notes about the relationship.

processors.name: Cal.diy or Cal.com (booking calendar)
processors.purpose: Books a call with the team, after your consent to load it.
processors.data: Name, email, the answers you give when booking.

processors.name: Stripe (payments)
processors.purpose: Takes payments, issues invoices and calculates tax.
processors.data: Billing name, email, address, payment method (held by Stripe, never by us).

processors.name: Dub Partners (referral program, when you refer someone)
processors.purpose: Tracks referrals and pays referral rewards.
processors.data: Referrer's email and organization, referred organization ids, payment amounts.
